key_insight: DeliMF combines structured ICU time series with clinical text to improve early delirium prediction, while reverting to structured-only prediction when text is unavailable.
clinical_relevance: Earlier identification of patients at risk of delirium could support timely clinical assessment, but clinical benefit has not been established.
method: Encode structured EHR time series with a temporal Transformer.
Encode time-stamped radiology reports with a clinical text encoder.
Fuse modalities through gated cross-attention with a patient-specific text weight.
evidence_signal: On an incident-only MIMIC-IV cohort, the abstract reports significant gains over baselines, especially for patients with text, with no reported performance loss for those without; ablations support the fusion design.
watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical performance estimates or external validation, leaving effect size and generalizability uncertain.
paper_title: DeliMF: Gated Cross-Attention Fusion of Structured Time Series and Clinical Text for Early Intensive Care Delirium Prediction
